messages.text:
Yes. Two things I need before I write anything into the calendar:

1. **Who and how long?** I assume the CSE455 TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana) plus you, 1 hour — confirm or correct. Should the department office be told, or just the TAs?
2. **A slot.** Next week's calendar (Mon 23 – Fri 27) is nearly full inside 09:00–17:00; the only free windows are:
   - Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30
   - Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30
   - Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30
   - Thu and Fri: nothing free at all

So an hour means moving or shortening something already booked. Want me to message the five TAs to find a slot that also suits them, and tell you what comes back? If you have a preferred day and time, say it and I'll offer that one instead.

Yes: the five TAs and me, one hour, and no need to bother the department office with this one.

The week looks tight, so please ask the TAs when they can come and bring me the slots that work for them — if nothing lines up, I'll move or shorten something myself.

Got it: the five TAs + you, one hour, department office out of the loop. I'm asking all five now for their free one-hour slots next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27, 09:00–17:00) and I'll bring you the ones that work for everyone.

One thing needs your call: Professor Alvarez wants the CSE455 staff meeting (one hour, Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, inside 09:00–17:00). Your week has no free hour — widest gaps are 30 min (Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30; Thu and Fri are back-to-back).

May I open an hour if he needs one — and how? Options: move a “Focus: …” block, shorten a Lunch, or move an Advisor 1:1. Say which and for which day, and I'll handle it.

Yes, if he needs an hour: shorten Wednesday's lunch to 12:00–12:30, which frees 12:30–13:30 right before the quiz section. Please don't move either Advisor 1:1 without me checking with them first — if that's the only hour that works, tell me and I'll ask.

Got it: Wednesday's lunch goes to 12:00–12:30 to free **Wed 12:30–13:30**, and I won't touch either Advisor 1:1. I've told Professor Alvarez that Wed 12:30–13:30 is the one hour Sarah can offer next week; I'll book it and log it if he takes it, and come back to you if only an Advisor 1:1 would work.
Sounds right, thanks. Let me know if he takes it.

All five TAs answered — and they all line up. The picture for next week:

**Nobody has a free hour** inside 09:00–17:00 (Thu and Fri are fully packed for every one of them, and for you too).

**Slots free for all five TAs and for your own calendar, no one moving anything:**
- **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30**
- **Wed 25, 10:00–10:30**

Anything longer needs commitments moved: a full hour would cost one block from at least one TA *and* one of yours (e.g. Wed 10:00–11:00 would eat your Grant writing; Tue 15:00–16:00 would eat your Research meeting). Diego, John, Hana, Priya's and Sarah's agents all said they can shift something if you name the slot.

So: shall I book a **30-minute** meeting at one of the two slots above, or do you want a full hour — name the day and time and I'll chase the moves on the TA side.

A full hour, please, and I'd rather give up my Tuesday research meeting than my Wednesday grant-writing block: book Tuesday 15:00–16:00 and ask the TAs to shift whatever they need. If someone genuinely can't move, tell me and we'll fall back to a 30-minute slot.

One update: Sarah's agent came back offering a full hour — **Wed 12:30–13:30** — but it doesn't work: Diego, John and Hana are booked Wed 12:30–13:00, Priya's only Wed gap is 10:00–10:30, and it would also clash with your Research meeting 12:30–13:00. She's holding off on moving anything.

So the answer stands: **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30** or **Wed 25, 10:00–10:30**, 30 minutes, nobody moving anything. Which shall I book?

Status, short: Professor Alvarez did **not** take the hour — no hour works for the five TAs at all. The meeting will most likely be a **30-minute** one, either **Tue 24th 15:00–15:30** or **Wed 25th 10:00–10:30**; both are already free in your week, so nothing needs moving and I won't book anything unless it lands in an occupied slot. Your Wed 12:30–13:30 offer stays on the table if he changes his mind. I'll ping you only if something actually changes in your calendar.

Sarah's Wednesday option doesn't work, agreed — drop it. As I said: Tuesday 24, 15:00–16:00, full hour, and ask the TAs who are booked then to shift; fall back to a 30-minute slot only if one of them really can't.
Fine by me either way — I'd lean to Wed 10:00–10:30, since Tuesday afternoon I'm usually deep in the CSE455 office-hours list before quiz section. Nothing to move, so no action needed from me.

Done. **Tuesday 24 Nov, 15:00–16:00 — CSE455 staff meeting** is booked in your calendar; I removed your Research meeting (15:30–16:30) and logged both lines, so nothing conflicts.

I've asked all five TAs to free that hour (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana all had 15:30–16:30 or 15:00–16:00 booked). I'll tell you the moment one of them says it's genuinely impossible — then we go to the 30-minute fallback (Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 10:00–10:30).
Full hour it is — booked.
Good. Thanks — ping me only if someone is stuck or can't move.
Understood — silence from me means everyone moved. I'll write only if one of them is stuck.

Priya — quick decision needed (CSE455 staff meeting, next week).

Professor Alvarez decided on **Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–16:00** and moved his own research meeting for it. For you, 15:00–15:30 is free, but 15:30–16:00 falls into **Focus: CSE444 project (15:30–16:30)**. There is no free hour anywhere else in your week — only 30-minute gaps — so I can't relocate that block.

Options, your call:
1. **Fallback (already offered by me):** 30-minute meeting, Tue 15:00–15:30 — no schedule change needed. ← my recommendation
2. Full hour Tue 15:00–16:00: I'd shorten **Focus: CSE444 project** to 16:00–16:30 (losing 30 min of focus time), or drop it that day.
3. Full hour by moving **Research group meeting (16:30–17:00)** — only if that meeting can shift, which I can't assume.

Say the word and I'll log the change and tell alvarez-agent. Nothing is changed yet.
Let's go with option 1: 30 minutes, Tue 15:00–15:30. I'd rather not touch my focus time, and I can't assume the research group meeting can move. Please log it and tell alvarez-agent.

**One blocker** — so pinging as agreed. Diego genuinely can't free Tue 15:00–16:00: the last half hour runs into the department **Seminar 15:30–17:00**, a university event he can't move, and the rest of his Tuesday is packed. So the fallback you set applies.

Both 30-minute options are free for all five TAs and for you:
- **Wed 25, 10:00–10:30** — nobody moves anything at all, and your Tue Research meeting 15:30–16:30 can go back in the calendar.
- **Tue 24, 15:00–15:30** — also clean; if you pick this, tell me whether to restore the Research meeting 15:30–16:30.

Which one? I'm leaving the calendar as it is (Tue 15:00–16:00 booked, Research meeting removed) until you say.

Then let's take Wednesday 25, 10:00–10:30 — nothing moves, and put my Tuesday Research meeting 15:30–16:30 back please. Thirty minutes is short but fine for a staff meeting; we can extend another week if we need to.

Short status: the full hour is dead — Tue 15:30–16:20 is your CSE455 office hours, not a gap, and it can't move (CSE452 lecture to 15:00, quiz section from 16:20), so no hour can be freed Tuesday either.

So the meeting is the 30-minute fallback and I've **booked Wed Nov 25, 10:00–10:30** (your preference, fits all five TAs) — it takes the front of your 10:30–12:00 office hours, nothing else moves. Logged in CALENDAR.md. Easy to switch to Tue 15:00–15:30 if the Professor prefers. No action needed from you.

Update on the other TAs (Sarah's still to answer): **John, Hana and Priya also can't free the full hour** — Tue 15:30–16:30 is a Study group for John, the Research group meeting for Hana, and Priya's CSE444 focus block, and none of them has another free hour to shift into. So it's four of five blocked; the full hour is effectively off, and we're on your fallback.

Preferences if you're indifferent: Priya leans **Tue 15:00–15:30**, Sarah (earlier) leaned **Wed 10:00–10:30**; the others are happy with either. Your call — just say Tue or Wed and I'll book it, restore your Tuesday Research meeting if we go with the half hour, and tell the TAs.
Thanks — Wed 10:00–10:30 is fine. Just to be precise, that ends right when office hours start, so nothing of the 10:30–12:00 block is lost. Leave it there unless the Professor asks for Tuesday.
Wednesday 25, 10:00–10:30, as I just said — book it, restore the Tuesday Research meeting, and let the TAs know. Priya and the others can live with 30 minutes on Wednesday.

Update: alvarez-agent says the full hour is off entirely (Diego, John and Hana are blocked too), and Professor Alvarez won't ask anyone to drop their own work — so your CSE444 focus block stays untouched, as you wanted.

He's now choosing between **Tue 24 15:00–15:30** (your preference, already booked and logged) and **Wed 25 10:00–10:30**. You're free either half hour; I'll move it and update the log if he picks Wednesday.
Fine — Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is my preference, but either half hour works for me. Just tell me which he picks.
Noted — I'll tell you as soon as he picks, and adjust the calendar and log if it's Wednesday.

Done — final calendar:

- **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** (you + Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana)
- **Tue 15:30–16:30 Research meeting restored**; Tuesday is back exactly as it was
- Log updated with both moves (booked the Wed meeting, put the Research meeting back)

All five TAs have been told the pick; Priya's agent had pre-logged Tuesday and is moving it to Wednesday, Sarah had already booked Wednesday, the rest are booking it now. Nothing conflicts, everybody stays inside 09:00–17:00, and no one had to drop their own commitment. I'll stay quiet unless something comes back wrong.

He picked **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30**. I've moved it: Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is free again, Wednesday 10:00–10:30 now reads "CSE455 staff meeting", and the log records the deletion and the new booking. alvarez-agent has been told.
Great, thanks — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 works for me.
Perfect — it stays on the calendar as Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30. Anything else you'd like me to take care of?
Nothing else for now — thanks for sorting it out so quickly.
Any time. I'm here on this channel whenever something comes up. 👋
